Capital Chronicle's midterm review: right scenario, wrong market call

Why it matters: Capital Chronicle's 5 November Main review delivers a blunt midterm lesson: the dossier's leading Democratic-sweep scenario occurred, yet US500, USTEC and Bitcoin rose against its downside mapping. Our market-direction map was wrong. Getting the political outcome right did not make the expected market response right.

Context: The same Main review calls a Democratic sweep the 'priced base case.' Capital Chronicle's interpretation is that an expected result need not tell us what fresh information a market will trade on. That is a competing explanation to examine, not proof that anticipation caused these rises.

Read the full brief: https://lnkd.in/gCrMBaTR

This is a retrospective of Capital Chronicle's dated dossier and review, not a performance record. Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.

Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
